# Pagination

**Status:** available. **Category:** navigation.

This repository's rules come first. Where this page disagrees with [Standards](../standards.md) or
[AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md), they win: no CDN, no npm, no images from other servers, no inline `style` or `onclick`.
Use the [macros](../../app/ui/templates/ui/macros.html) where one exists.

Pagination is a group of buttons.

[Pagination documentation](https://daisyui.com/components/pagination/)

## Class names
- component: `join`
- part: `join-item`
- direction: `join-vertical`, `join-horizontal`

## Syntax
```html
<div class="join">{CONTENT}</div>
```

## Rules
- Use `join-item` for each button or link in the pagination.
- Use the `btn` class to style pagination items.
